label: judgment
explanation: Three disqualifying mismatches. (1) Title: 'Software Engineer - Backend' does not align with either of Priya's target roles ('AI Engineer / ML Engineer' or 'Data Engineer'). (2) Description: the role explicitly requires proficiency in Java, Scala, or Go; Priya's skills.languages contains only Python and SQL, and no other resume field supplies those backend languages. (3) Location: the posting is in Aarhus, Denmark; Priya needs sponsorship (profile.needs_sponsorship: true) and the posting contains no mention of visa or relocation sponsorship support. The experience requirement (2+ years) is within the cap of 3, and no security-clearance exclusion is triggered, but the role and skills mismatches alone make it not relevant.
